verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that individual users can export their user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy, and that exports include both conversation data and account user data, which covers the story's core. Enterprise users additionally get programmatic chat-history access via the Compliance API. missing for 10: details on export format and completeness (e.g. project files, artifacts, memory), independent or hands-on corroboration of the export working.
